name: Harbor Bell
lore: A penguin harbour guide who turns dangerous ground into safe crossings. Modest damage is balanced by carefully placed rescue buoys and moving projectile cover.

primary.name: Harbor Note
primary.description: A short sound ring deals 16 damage and slows enemies by 25% for 0.8s.

secondary.name: Rescue Buoy
secondary.description: Place a 110-radius buoy for 4s: allies heal 4 HP/s and receive 12% damage reduction.

special.name: Safe Passage
special.description: A protective front moves for 3s. Allies crossing it heal 12 once and gain 20% protection. Absorbs up to 12 enemy projectiles.

passive: Harbor Watch: Harbor Note grants nearby allies within 110 a 10% protective ward for 0.8s.

technique.name: Restful Note

attack.name: Restful Note
attack.description: A close pulse heals friendly heroes, including you, for 4 HP after 1 second. No damage.

technique.description: Trade the damaging/slow ring for close, delayed healing.

final_technique.name: Hush Buoy

attack.name: Hush Buoy
attack.description: A 125-radius buoy absorbs up to 12 enemy shots over 4s. No healing or ward.

final_technique.description: Trade healing and protection for projectile interception.
